Student dashboard

Your next class. Your next step.

A schedule-first day planner, with called-ticket attention, a readable agenda and a separate service-ticket rail.

Published weekdays and raw timetable times stay honest. Campus news and independent queue errors no longer compete with the next class.

14

Campus map

Explore a building. Find your room.

A map-first explorer with building search, an indoor floor mode and focused room details. Route previews still come from the backend.

Missing geometry stays missing: room points are not invented walls. Saved positions are labelled as saved, not live presence.

15

Staff queue directory

A clear view of the lines you run.

An operational directory with assigned lines, open/closed filters, honest counts and a clear route into each queue console.

Closed queues remain accessible. Scope is enforced by the existing backend policy, and state changes require confirmed server replies.

Staff ticket workbench

One line. A clear next action.

State-grouped tickets with one global Call next action, a selected-student workspace and read-only queue policies.

Desk presence, admission, completion and no-show have deliberate review steps. On narrow screens, selecting a ticket focuses its action panel.

Verification & remaining work

Four individual pages, one regression suite.

All 211 fixture-backed web checks passed together in 4.7 minutes. Production build, lint, web/mobile typechecks and PHP syntax/API-contract gates passed. Protected landing source hashes are unchanged; strict 1440 × 5065 cold/client pixel comparison has zero differing channels after all new styles load.

Backend test limitation: two new Laravel scope tests are written but were not executed because PHP and backend dependencies are unavailable here. Browser fixtures do not certify live transactions, multi-operator concurrency, physical positioning, WebSocket delivery or accessibility compliance. Self-review scores are subjective.

Still pending: the remaining staff dashboard, offices, rooms, timetable and content pages, and the nine admin pages. This is not a completed all-role redesign.
